text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Tap Dance City and the others 
brought me to a ramen shop. And what took 
place there was—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Delicious! That's the last bite. 'Big 
Eater Challenge' successfully cleared!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Congrats, Tap♪ As the one who introduced 
you to the shop, I'm proud as can be.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, thanks Fine! Thanks to you, I got 
the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Ain't you somethin', missy! ...Hey, wanna 
try your hand at the secret challenge 
too?"

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Its name is the "Dream Extra-Extra 
Challenge"! We're taking on an even more 
mega-sized portion!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wah, that looks yummy~ ...Though having 
them back-to-back might be a bit tough?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? If you finish within the time 
limit, you'd win a luxury cruise ticket, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do it!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, isn't it? Cruising across the 
open ocean on a luxury liner is the very 
definition of romance, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"And on this journey, I'm sure a treasure 
awaits us—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Full stomach? Doesn't matter! The treasure 
is calling for me!!
choice_data_list:
You should take on the challenge when 
you're hungry.
Alright! Let's give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Why!? We should be going full speed ahead 
here!"
choice_data_list:
If you push yourself too hard and end up 
missing your chance, it'll all be for 
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... True, I can't say I'm in peak 
condition right now, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It looks like there's still time left in 
the challenge period, so wouldn't a 
strategic retreat be an option?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. Alright, I'll get into top shape 
and come back!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with a determined Tap Dance City, 
I left the ramen shop.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "YEAH! This cruising run is mine!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Still haven't reached the bottom!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, time's almost up—

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, time's up! Come back and try 
again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The challenge ended with bitter results, 
leaving behind nothing but the fact that 
they had eaten way too much ramen.
